{"content": "package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"io"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/godinj/drem-orchestrator/internal/inbox"
	"github.com/godinj/drem-orchestrator/internal/testutil"
	"github.com/jinzhu/gorm"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestSendCommand_CreatesMessage(t *testing.T) {
	db := testutil.NewTestDB(t)
	defer db.Close()
	db.AutoMigrate(&inbox.Message{})

	args := []string{
		"send",
		"--from", "kyle",
		"--to", "alex",
		"--subject", "Test",
		"--priority", "high",
		"--type", "request",
		"--body", "Hello",
	}

	err := run(args, db, io.Discard)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	var msg inbox.Message
	err = db.First(&msg, "from = ? AND to = ?", "kyle", "alex").Error
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, "Test", msg.Subject)
	assert.Equal(t, "high", msg.Priority)
	assert.Equal(t, "request", msg.Type)
	assert.Equal(t, "Hello", msg.Body)
}

func TestSendCommand_MissingRequiredFlags(t *testing.T) {
	db := testutil.NewTestDB(t)
	defer db.Close()
	db.AutoMigrate(&inbox.Message{})

	args := []string{
		"send",
		"--to", "alex",
		"--subject", "Test",
	}

	err := run(args, db, io.Discard)
	require.Error(t, err)
	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "missing required flag: --from")
}

func TestListCommand_ShowsUnreadMessages(t *testing.T) {
	db := testutil.NewTestDB(t)
	defer db.Close()
	db.AutoMigrate(&inbox.Message{})

	m1 := inbox.Message{From: "alice", To: "mike", Subject: "Msg 1", Archived: false}
	m2 := inbox.Message{From: "bob", To: "mike", Subject: "Msg 2", Archived: false}
	m3 := inbox.Message{From: "charlie", To: "mike", Subject: "Archived", Archived: true}
	m4 := inbox.Message{From: "dave", To: "other", Subject: "Other", Archived: false}

	err := db.Create(&m1).Error
	require.NoError(t, err)
	err = db.Create(&m2).Error
	require.NoError(t, err)
	err = db.Create(&m3).Error
	require.NoError(t, err)
	err = db.Create(&m4).Error
	require.NoError(t, err)

	var buf bytes.Buffer
	args := []string{"list", "--agent", "mike"}
	err = run(args, db, &buf)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	output := buf.String()
	assert.Contains(t, output, "Msg 1")
	assert.Contains(t, output, "Msg 2")
	assert.NotContains(t, output, "Archived")
	assert.NotContains(t, output, "Other")
}

func TestArchiveCommand_ArchivesMessage(t *testing.T) {
	db := testutil.NewTestDB(t)
	defer db.Close()
	db.AutoMigrate(&inbox.Message{})

	msg := inbox.Message{From: "a", To: "b", Subject: "S", Archived: false}
	err := db.Create(&msg).Error
	require.NoError(t, err)

	args := []string{"archive", "--id", msg.ID.String()}
	err = run(args, db, io.Discard)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	var updatedMsg inbox.Message
	err = db.First(&updatedMsg, msg.ID).Error
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.True(t, updatedMsg.Archived)
}

func TestWatchCommand_ExitsOnContext(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	
	// We need to run this in a way that we can cancel it.
	// Since handleWatch is synchronous and returns when ctx is done,
	// we can call it directly.
	
	errChan := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		errChan <- handleWatch(ctx)
	}()

	// Give it a tiny bit to start
	time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
	cancel()

	err := <-errChan
	assert.Error(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, context.Canceled, err)
}

func TestSendCommand_CreatesMessage(t *testing.T) {
	db := testutil.NewTestDB(t)
	defer db.Close()
	db.AutoMigrate(&csuite.CsuiteInboxMessage{})

	args := []string{
		"send",
		"--from", "kyle",
		"--to", "alex",
		"--subject", "Test",
		"--priority", "high",
		"--type", "request",
		"--body", "Hello",
	}

	err := run(args, db, io.Discard)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	var msg csuite.CsuiteInboxMessage
	err = db.First(&msg, "from = ? AND to = ?", "kyle", "alex").Error
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, "Test", msg.Subject)
	assert.Equal(t, "high", msg.Priority)
	assert.Equal(t, "request", msg.Type)
	assert.Equal(t, "Hello", msg.Body)
}

func TestSendCommand_MissingRequiredFlags(t *testing.T) {
	db := testutil.NewTestDB(t)
	defer db.Close()
	db.AutoMigrate(&csuite.CsuiteInboxMessage{})

	args := []string{
		"send",
		"--to", "alex",
		"--subject", "Test",
	}

	err := run(args, db, io.Discard)
	require.Error(t, err)
	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "missing required flag: --from")
}

func TestListCommand_ShowsUnreadMessages(t *testing.T) {
	db := testutil.NewTestDB(t)
	defer db.Close()
	db.AutoMigrate(&csuite.CsuiteInboxMessage{})

	m1 := csuite.CsuiteInboxMessage{From: "alice", To: "mike", Subject: "Msg 1", Archived: false}
	m2 := csuite.CsuiteInboxMessage{From: "bob", To: "mike", Subject: "Msg 2", Archived: false}
	m3 := csuite.CsuiteInboxMessage{From: "charlie", To: "mike", Subject: "Archived", Archived: true}
	m4 := csuite.CsuiteInboxMessage{From: "dave", To: "other", Subject: "Other", Archived: false}

	err := db.Create(&m1).Error
	require.NoError(t, err)
	err = db.Create(&m2).Error
	require.NoError(t, err)
	err = db.Create(&m3).Error
	require.NoError(t, err)
	err = db.Create(&m4).Error
	require.NoError(t, err)

	var buf bytes.Buffer
	args := []string{"list", "--agent", "mike"}
	err = run(args, db, &buf)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	output := buf.String()
	assert.Contains(t, output, "Msg 1")
	assert.Contains(t, output, "Msg 2")
	assert.NotContains(t, output, "Archived")
	assert.NotContains(t, output, "Other")
}

func TestArchiveCommand_ArchivesMessage(t *testing.T) {
	db := testutil.NewTestDB(t)
	defer db.Close()
	db.AutoMigrate(&csuite.CsuiteInboxMessage{})

	msg := csuite.CsuiteInboxMessage{From: "a", To: "b", Subject: "S", Archived: false}
	err := db.Create(&msg).Error
	require.NoError(t, err)

	args := []string{"archive", "--id", msg.ID.String()}
	err = run(args, db, io.Discard)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	var updatedMsg csuite.CsuiteInboxMessage
	err = db.First(&updatedMsg, msg.ID)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.True(t, updatedMsg.Archived)
}

func TestWatchCommand_ExitsOnContext(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	
	errChan := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		errChan <- handleWatch(ctx)
	}()

	time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
	cancel()

	err := <-errChan
	assert.Error(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, context.Canceled, err)
}
